Kenney Skyboxes 1.0 - daytime and warm sky variants
Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/skyboxes
Author: Kenney
License: CC0 1.0; original License.txt included.
Downloaded: 2026-11-17
skybox-day.png and skybox-morning.png are imported; original artwork is unmodified.
The opening currently uses Morning (warm yellow/peach); Day is kept for comparison.

Used for the sea-surface opening in ImmersiveOpening.
Static panoramic sky, no cloud simulation, reflection capture, or added lights.
Import limit: 2048; Android override: ASTC 6x6, mipmaps, no CPU read/write copy.
Material: Assets/Reefkeeper/Generated/SurfaceIntro/SurfaceSky_Morning.mat
Underwater sky and lighting are restored by the existing OpeningDiveSequence.
Real PICO GPU cost and visual sharpness still require headset profiling.
